narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>A cube has six faces, and here are six squares, so it folds into a cube.
<bookmark mark='slots'/>Six squares are needed, but each must land on a different face.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Where the squares are joined decides if the box closes.

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>Fold one square at a time, and name the face it lands on.
<bookmark mark='two'/>Every face must be covered once, with none left open.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. A row of four has one square above and one below the second square. Is it a net of a cube?
